title: The rescaled chart is an injective parametrization of the blow-up with the same derivative
statement: Let m, N ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝᵐ open, φ : ℝᵐ → ℝ^N differentiable on V and injective on V, v₀ ∈ ℝᵐ and r ∈ ℝ with r ≠ 0. Put U_r := {u ∈ ℝᵐ : v₀ + ru ∈ V} and ψ_r(u) := r⁻¹(φ(v₀ + ru) − φ(v₀)). Then (i) U_r is open; (ii) ψ_r is injective on U_r; (iii) ψ_r(U_r) = η_{φ(v₀),r}(φ(V)), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) is Chapter03.blowUpMap x r; (iv) for every u ∈ U_r, ψ_r has Fréchet derivative fderiv ℝ φ (v₀ + ru) at u (HasFDerivAt).
lean_statement: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn m)) (φ : Rn m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (v₀ : Rn m) (r : ℝ), IsOpen V → DifferentiableOn ℝ φ V → InjOn φ V → r ≠ 0 → IsOpen {u : Rn m | v₀ + r • u ∈ V} ∧ InjOn (fun u : Rn m => r⁻¹ • (φ (v₀ + r • u) - φ v₀)) {u : Rn m | v₀ + r • u ∈ V} ∧ (fun u : Rn m => r⁻¹ • (φ (v₀ + r • u) - φ v₀)) '' {u : Rn m | v₀ + r • u ∈ V} = Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap (φ v₀) r '' (φ '' V) ∧ ∀ u ∈ {u : Rn m | v₀ + r • u ∈ V}, HasFDerivAt (fun u : Rn m => r⁻¹ • (φ (v₀ + r • u) - φ v₀)) (fderiv ℝ φ (v₀ + r • u)) u
